ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RT4,
Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District, and B3-2, Community Shopping
District, symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 15-J in the area bound by:

West Devon Avenue, North Kedzie Avenue; the centerline of the West Rosemont
Avenue right-of-way if such right-of-way were extended directly west of and
perpendicular to North Kedzie Avenue; and the North Shore Channel

to those of a RS3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

AW

Debra Silverstein ~’ Y

Alderwoman, 50‘ Ward

Common Address:
6306-46 North Kedzie and 3201-15 West Devon Avenues
